name: neowiki_subject
comment: One row per Subject per page holding it, as of the revision the page publishes (its RevisionPolicy decides which). Written with the revision or rebuild that changes it, in the same transaction. A page that publishes nothing has no rows.

columns.name: nws_page_id
columns.comment: Page whose subject slot holds the Subject

columns.name: nws_subject_id
columns.comment: Subject id, bare: a slot holds Subjects of this wiki only

columns.name: nws_schema
columns.comment: Name of the Subject's Schema, without its Source, cut to 255 bytes on a character boundary

columns.name: nws_display_name
columns.comment: The label, else the page name for a Main Subject on a page not titled by a Subject id (SubjectDisplayName::labelOrPageName). Null when neither applies: such a Subject has a generated name.

columns.name: nws_display_name_key
columns.comment: nws_display_name as CaseInsensitiveKey makes it, for case-insensitive matching and ordering. Null when nws_display_name is.

columns.name: nws_page_key
columns.comment: The page name (prefixed title text, with spaces) as CaseInsensitiveKey makes it

columns.name: nws_dependent
columns.comment: 1 for a Dependent Subject: one whose Schema declared its Subjects dependent when the row was written

columns.name: nws_edited
columns.comment: Timestamp of the page's published revision

indexes.name: nws_subject_id
indexes.comment: Index for finding a Subject by id, and for listing Subjects by id

indexes.name: nws_schema_subject_id
indexes.comment: Index for listing and counting the Subjects of one Schema

indexes.name: nws_display_name_key
indexes.comment: Index for matching and ordering Subjects by display name

indexes.name: nws_schema_display_name_key
indexes.comment: Index for matching and ordering the Subjects of one Schema by display name
